No. IS-1(3)2003 /Norms/Vol.II/39638 Date: 12.02.2016

To
All Regional PF Commissioners (In-charge of Region),

Sub:- Revised and supplementary norms for IT equipments for field offices-
reg.

Ref: (i) Head Office letter No. WSU/28[1)2003/delegation dated 13.04.2004.
(ii) Letter no.IS-1(3)2003/Norms/ 18728 dated 07.10.2009,
(iii)Letter no. IS-1(3)2003 /Norms/ 101987 dated 06.03.2009.
(iv)Letter no.IS- 1(3)2003 /Norms/8284 dated 11.09.2014.
{v) Letter no.IS-1(3)2003/Norms/24952 dated 25.11.2014.

Madam/ Sir,
With reference to the subject cited above, I am directed to convey the norms

for supplementary requirements of desktop PCs and printers for every field office as
follows:

(i) For the Compliance Division one PC for handling every 5 Lac
accounts.

(ii) One PC for Legal Section.

(iii) One PC for Exemption Section.

(iv) One PC for Recovery Section for every 10 Lac accounts.

(v) One PC for Damages Section for every 10 Lac accounts.

(vi) One PC for Administration Section for every 15 Lac accounts.

(vii) One PC for Aadhaar based bio metric attendance system,

(viii) One PC for Cash Section for every 15 Lac accounts.

(ix) One PC for facilitation center for every 10 Lac accounts.

(x) One PC for Inspectorate Cell / Office.

2. As regards printers it has been decided to enhance the limit for purchase of
printers to Rs. 50,000/- from the existing Rs. 15,000/-

3. In so far as the procurement of computers and printers in respect of Head
Office is concerned, it has been decided that all Head Office requirements shall be
processed and procured by the ACC (ASD)/RPFC-I (ASD), as the case may be, on
actual need basis within their delegated powers.

4, The purchases shall be made locally by each office strictly by following GFR
norms and CVC guidelines that are issued from time to time and special note may
be made that while purchasing printers, utmost caution must be exercised while
delibrating the need, requirement and purchase by each office individually. It may

be ensured that while deciding upon the printers the specification of printers are
strictly need based for every field office.

5. Based upon the account figures as on 31.03.2015, the distribution of
computers have been made and are enclosed for information and necessary action
by each Regional Office and the Sub-Regional Offices under their respective
jurisdiction. The revised requirement of computers may be assessed at the level of
concerned Regional Office keeping in view the account figures as on the last date of
financial year. For instance, the revision in the distribution of computers as
enclosed may be made in the next financial year on the basis of account figures as
on 31.03.2016. The additional equipments arrived at may be procured at Regional
Office level under intimation to Head Office.

(This issues with the approval of Central PF Commissioner),

Yours faithfully

(Jag Mohan)
ACC (IS)
